name: shc_authenticate_farmer
description: Authenticates a farmer using Aadhaar and OTP. Requires farmer to be registered in the Aadhaar database. aadhaar_number must be exactly 12 digits, mobile_number 10 digits, and otp 6 digits. Returns session_token and farmer profile details. Does not register a new farmer or plot. Fails if OTP is incorrect or expired, or if mobile number is not linked to Aadhaar.

otp.description: 6-digit one time password sent to the mobile number [EXACT]

name: shc_validate_land_records
description: Validates land ownership against state revenue records. Requires land records to be digitized in the state database. state_code, district_code, sub_district_code, village_code, and survey_number must be valid alphanumeric identifiers. Returns owner_name, land_area_hectares, and irrigation_type. Does not register the plot for the SHC scheme. Fails if the survey number does not exist or if the land is disputed in revenue records.

survey_number.description: Land parcel survey or khasra number [EXACT]

name: shc_get_nearby_labs
description: Retrieves a list of MoA&FW-accredited soil testing labs in a given district. Requires the district to have at least one registered lab. state_code and district_code must be valid administrative codes. Returns list of lab_id, lab_name, address, and contact details. Does not assign a lab to a specific soil sample. Fails if the district code is invalid or if no accredited lab is available for the district.

name: shc_get_sampling_window
description: Retrieves the recommended post-harvest soil sampling window for a specific cropping season and district. Requires the state agricultural department to have published the seasonal calendar. district_code must be valid and cropping_season must be a recognized season. Returns start_date and end_date for optimal soil collection. Does not schedule a sample collection appointment. Fails if the cropping season is invalid or if the district calendar is not published.

cropping_season.description: The agricultural season, must be one of kharif, rabi, summer, year_round [EXACT]

name: shc_register_plot
description: Registers a verified land parcel to a farmer's profile for the SHC scheme. Requires an authenticated session and plot_registration_status of not_registered. survey_number must match revenue records, land_area_hectares must be greater than 0, and irrigation_type must be valid. Returns plot_id and plot_registration_status as registered. Does not automatically request a soil sample collection. Fails if the farmer is not the registered owner in revenue records or if the plot is already registered.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private plot, sample, and card data [TYPE_ONLY]

survey_number.description: Land parcel survey or khasra number [EXACT]

land_area_hectares.description: Total area of the land parcel in hectares [EXACT]

irrigation_type.description: Type of irrigation, must be one of irrigated, rain_fed, partially_irrigated [EXACT]

name: shc_request_sample_collection
description: Submits a request for soil sample collection from a registered plot. Requires an authenticated session, plot_registration_status of verified, and sample_collection_status of not_requested. plot_id must be valid and requested_date must fall within the recommended sampling window. Returns sample_id, scheduled collection date, and assigned field officer details. Does not perform the soil test or assign the testing lab. Fails if the sampling window is closed, if a sample request is already active for this plot in the current cycle, or if the plot is not verified.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private plot, sample, and card data [TYPE_ONLY]

plot_id.description: Unique soil health card plot identifier [TYPE_ONLY]

requested_date.description: Desired date for sample collection in YYYY-MM-DD format [EXACT]

name: shc_get_sample_status
description: Retrieves the current tracking status of a soil sample. Requires the sample to have been requested and assigned a sample_id. sample_id must be a valid alphanumeric identifier. Returns sample_collection_status and last updated timestamp. Does not return soil test results or nutrient parameters. Fails if the sample_id does not exist or if the sample was lost in transit before being logged.

sample_id.description: Unique soil sample identifier assigned at collection [TYPE_ONLY]

name: shc_get_lab_assignment
description: Retrieves the details of the testing lab assigned to a specific soil sample. Requires sample_collection_status to be at least collected. sample_id must be a valid identifier. Returns lab_id, lab_name, lab_assignment_status, and expected_completion_date. Does not change the assigned lab or expedite the testing process. Fails if the sample_id is invalid or if the lab_assignment_status is pending.

sample_id.description: Unique soil sample identifier assigned at collection [TYPE_ONLY]

name: shc_get_test_status
description: Checks the progress of the soil test at the assigned lab. Requires sample_collection_status to be received_at_lab. sample_id must be a valid identifier. Returns test_status and completion_date if applicable. Does not generate the soil health card or provide the actual nutrient values. Fails if the sample has not yet reached the lab or if test results are delayed beyond 30 days without an update.

sample_id.description: Unique soil sample identifier assigned at collection [TYPE_ONLY]

name: shc_get_soil_health_card
description: Retrieves the complete soil health card document for a tested sample. Requires an authenticated session, test_status of completed, and card_status of issued. sample_id must be valid and linked to the authenticated farmer. Returns card_id, issuance_date, 12 macro and micronutrient levels, and overall soil health index. Does not provide crop-specific fertilizer recommendations. Fails if the test is still in progress, if the card has not been issued, or if the farmer is not the owner of the sample.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private plot, sample, and card data [TYPE_ONLY]

sample_id.description: Unique soil sample identifier assigned at collection [TYPE_ONLY]

name: shc_get_fertilizer_recommendation
description: Looks up crop-specific fertilizer and amendment recommendations based on a soil health card. Requires card_status to be issued and not expired. card_id must be valid and crop_name must be in the valid crop registry for the district. Returns recommended doses of urea, DAP, MOP, and organic manure in kg per hectare. Does not order fertilizers or process DBT subsidies. Fails if the card_id is invalid, if the card is expired being older than 3 years, or if the crop is not in the farmer's registered cropping pattern.

crop_name.description: Name of the crop for which recommendations are sought [SUBSTRING]

name: shc_compare_historical_cards
description: Compares nutrient parameters across multiple soil health card cycles for the same plot. Requires an authenticated session and at least two issued cards for the given plot_id. plot_id must be valid and belong to the authenticated farmer. Returns historical trends for pH, EC, OC, and primary nutrients across different issuance dates. Does not merge cards or extend the validity of an expired card. Fails if the plot_id is invalid or if historical comparison is requested with only one card on record.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private plot, sample, and card data [TYPE_ONLY]

plot_id.description: Unique soil health card plot identifier [TYPE_ONLY]

name: shc_request_retest
description: Submits a request to re-test a soil sample if the farmer disputes the results. Requires an authenticated session, test_status of completed, and retest_status of not_applicable. sample_id must be valid and dispute_reason must be provided. Returns retest_request_id and updated retest_status as requested. Does not collect a new physical soil sample from the field. Fails if requested after the 15-day dispute window, if a retest was already requested for this cycle, or if requested for a sample with no card issued.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private plot, sample, and card data [TYPE_ONLY]

sample_id.description: Unique soil sample identifier assigned at collection [TYPE_ONLY]

dispute_reason.description: Detailed reason for disputing the test results [SUBSTRING]

name: shc_raise_grievance
description: Registers a formal complaint regarding the soil health card scheme processes. Requires an authenticated session and either a requested sample or an issued card. grievance_category must be valid and complaint_description must be at least 20 characters. Returns grievance_id and expected resolution timeframe. Does not instantly resolve the issue or directly contact the lab. Fails if the grievance is about a card that was never issued, or if a duplicate grievance exists for the same issue.

session_token.description: Active authentication token obtained after Aadhaar OTP verification. Required for tools that perform write operations or access private plot, sample, and card data [TYPE_ONLY]

grievance_category.description: Category of the complaint, must be one of sample_not_collected, test_delay, card_not_issued, incorrect_results, advisory_not_generated, lab_assignment_dispute [EXACT]

complaint_description.description: Detailed description of the issue faced by the farmer [SUBSTRING]

related_id.description: The sample_id or card_id related to the grievance [TYPE_ONLY]

name: shc_track_grievance_status
description: Retrieves the current status and resolution remarks of a submitted grievance. Requires a previously generated grievance_id. grievance_id must be a valid alphanumeric identifier. Returns current_status, assigned_officer, and resolution_remarks. Does not escalate the grievance to a higher authority. Fails if the grievance_id does not exist in the system.

grievance_id.description: Unique identifier for the submitted grievance [TYPE_ONLY]
